√khad 'be hard'
present: -khadánt? 
[perfect: cakhāda etc. ]
derivatives: khadā khadirá V.+ 
Very doubtful root; the occurrence in ŚB. perhaps a false reading.

√khād 'chew'
present: [1.] kā́dati etc. V.+ 
perfect: cakhā́da etc. V.+ 
[aorist: acakhādat akhādīt ]
future: [1.] khādiṣyate khādiṣyati -- [2.] khāditā 
verbal: khāditá B.+ khāditvā 
secondary: passive: khādyate -- intensive: cākhād- -- desiderative: cikhādiṣati E.+ -- causative: khādayati etc. E.+ 
derivatives: khādá V.+ khādaka S.+ khādin E.+ khādya E.+ khādana E.+ khadanīya C. khā́das- RV. khāditavya C. khāditṛ C. cikhādiṣu E.+
